body: Sam LaPorta is on the Detroit Lions roster but faces intense pressure regarding his contract extension. Reports indicate he is prepared to leave the team if negotiations fail, while the Lions are reportedly considering trading him to the Kansas City Chiefs for a draft pick. The situation involves significant speculation about his free agency status and potential departures, with no confirmed agreement reached yet.

findings.evidence_quote: Lions Predicted to Flip Unhappy Sam LaPorta for Chiefs DB, First-Round Pick
Sam LaPorta says he is prepared to leave Detroit if the Lions won't give him a new contract
